exercises.name: Diamond push-up
exercises.rationale: Narrow hands make elbow extension (triceps) the limiter; shoulder horizontal adduction (chest, front delt) is secondary.

exercises.name: Table triceps extension
exercises.rationale: Bodyweight skull-crusher on a table edge: elbow extension only (triceps).

exercises.name: Band curl
exercises.rationale: Elbow flexion only (biceps), with resistance rising toward the top.

exercises.name: Bench dip
exercises.rationale: Elbow extension with hands on a bench behind you: triceps, with shoulders in extension.

exercises.name: Chair dip
exercises.rationale: Elbow extension with hands on a chair behind you: triceps, with shoulders in extension.

exercises.name: Band triceps pushdown
exercises.rationale: Elbow extension against a band anchored high: triceps isolation.

exercises.name: Band overhead triceps extension
exercises.rationale: Elbow extension with arms overhead: the long head of the triceps works stretched.

exercises.name: Band hammer curl
exercises.rationale: Elbow flexion with a neutral grip: biceps and the forearm flexors.

exercises.name: Dumbbell curl
exercises.rationale: Elbow flexion with a supinated grip: biceps.

exercises.name: Dumbbell hammer curl
exercises.rationale: Elbow flexion with a neutral grip: biceps plus forearm flexors.

exercises.name: Concentration curl
exercises.rationale: Seated one-arm curl braced on the thigh: strict biceps isolation.

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell curl
exercises.rationale: Curling with the arms behind the body on an incline bench: biceps at long length.

exercises.name: Dumbbell overhead triceps extension
exercises.rationale: Elbow extension with arms overhead: long head of the triceps stretched.

exercises.name: Dumbbell skull crusher
exercises.rationale: Lying elbow extension: triceps, with the long head partly stretched.

exercises.name: Dumbbell kickback
exercises.rationale: Elbow extension bent over: triceps peak at full lockout, so shortened rather than lengthened.

exercises.name: Close-grip dumbbell floor press
exercises.rationale: Floor press with dumbbells touching and elbows tucked: elbow extension leads (triceps), chest and front delts help; the floor limits the range for the shoulders.

exercises.name: Zottman curl
exercises.rationale: Curl up with palms up, turn and lower with palms down: biceps on the way up, forearms work hard on the slow lowering.
